threshold_selection: The threshold is the higher-interpolation 99th percentile of the class-1 score on 150 PixArt calibration real-photo controls (IDs 351--425, indoor/outdoor). It was frozen before every ID 426--500 held-out evaluation and the self-generated regression check.
target_definition: A strict complementary AI-oriented pixel signal. It is neither a real-world AI prevalence probability nor evidence of provenance, authenticity, or camera origin.

runtime.architecture: Released Nonescape Mini EfficientNet-v2-S backbone plus 1024-to-2 classifier head
runtime.isolation: One short-lived worker process per uploaded image; the checkpoint SHA-256 is verified before launching it.
runtime.upstream_class_mapping: The release does not document class indices. Class 1 was direction-validated only on the independent PixArt calibration cohort before applying the frozen threshold.

calibration.dataset: Projective Geometry Recent PixArt indoor/outdoor, IDs 351--425

held_out_cross_generator_original.protocol: Deepfloyd, Kandinsky, PixArt, and SDXL; IDs 426--500; 525 generated and 525 real images. The product rule is an OR of independently frozen Community Forensics and Nonescape Mini high thresholds.

held_out_cross_generator_jpeg85.protocol: The same 1,050 source images are independently JPEG-85 re-encoded before both detectors. The product retains the strict original-decode Nonescape threshold because upload history cannot be inferred safely from a file extension.

self_generated_complex_station_regressio.protocol: Normal complex station image generated by ChatGPT image generation, stripped of metadata; evaluated after original decode and after separate JPEG-85 re-encoding. This regression was not used for direction or threshold selection.
self_generated_complex_station_regressio.result: Both variants cross the frozen product high-confidence threshold.

limitations: nonescape_mini_source_checkpoint_has_no_publisher_cryptographic_checksum; Demirror pins the retrieved file hash locally
